name: Alpengasthof Gruberhof
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Gruberhof is situated on a plateau above Söll. The rooms feature balconies with panoramic views of the Kaiser Mountains. The restaurant serves traditional dishes prepared with regional ingredients. In winter, a ski bus transports guests directly to the lifts of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser. In summer, the inn serves as an immediate starting point for hikes and mountain bike tours. A wellness area with a sauna and a sunbathing lawn complement the amenities. The property is family-run.
